stage0056_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$三島$$
「...Thank you for your trouble, Major $$オズマ$$.
　I've received your $c resupply request.」

stage0056_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That thing I requested, is it in?」

stage0056_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$三島$$
「Here's $$大統領$$ Howard's signature
　authorizing the Reaction Missile and MDE Shell.」

stage0056_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Only those two armaments are handled
　specially - they need the signature of
　the Frontier fleet's $$大統領$$, as manager.」

stage0056_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$三島$$
「I'm glad to have been of help.」

stage0056_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$オズマ$$
「How admirable.
　You're not thinking 'that signature should've
　been mine,' by any chance, are you?」

stage0056_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Don't forget, Secretary $$三島$$?
　That we still hold proof of your betrayal
　from the time of the $$再世戦争$$.」

stage0056_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$三島$$
「O-of course I remember.
　That's why I'm doing you this favor...」

stage0056_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$オズマ$$
「It's that very attitude I'm warning you about.」

stage0056_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「All we ask is that you do your duty fairly.
　No personal feelings or ambition mixed in.」

stage0056_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'm counting on you, Secretary.
　Cooperate with the $$大統領$$, and keep the fleet
　neutral, without being swayed by meddling.」

stage0056_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「We were invited by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s sponsor, right?」

stage0056_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ルカ$$
「This is definitely the place they said...」

stage0056_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アルト$$
「What is this place!?
　Why is there a $$くろがね屋$$ inside the fleet!?」

stage0056_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シェリル$$
「That's... because it's my favorite.」

stage0056_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Nice greeting, $$アルト$$.
　Is that any way to talk to a sponsor?」

stage0056_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Guess you didn't know.
　Actually... I've become one of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s investors.」

stage0056_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「I never heard anything about that!」

stage0056_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Of course not.
　I never told you.」

stage0056_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ランカ$$
「$$シェリル$$ wanted to surprise you all,
　so she secretly opened this $$くろがね屋$$ branch.」

stage0056_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Of course, I got the proprietress's okay.
　It's not fed straight from the spring,
　but I made the water the same.」

stage0056_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, I can't believe it...
　It looks exactly like $$くろがね屋$$ in Atami...」

stage0056_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$キラ$$
「Guess that's the Galactic Fairy's magic.」

stage0056_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アルト$$
「Forget you being $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s sponsor for now,
　what are you planning by calling us here?」

stage0056_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　To thank everyone for their hard work,
　we're all taking a hot spring bath.」

stage0056_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シェリル$$
「What's wrong, everyone?
　Mixed bathing, and you're all so low-energy.」

stage0056_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$桂$$
「Mixed bathing, sure, but just a foot bath.
　You got me on that one.」

stage0056_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ha, figured it'd end up like this anyway...」

stage0056_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$モーム$$
「By the way, what's with all these bananas?」

stage0056_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ brought them,
　saying Atami means bananas, or something.」

stage0056_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シュレード$$
「As always, I can't understand what he does.」

stage0056_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$クラン$$
「Whatever, but this banana... isn't ripe yet.」

stage0056_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シン$$
「If he's going to bring us treats anyway,
　he could at least make them edible.」

stage0056_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「This is my first foot bath, and it feels nice.」

stage0056_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$エマ$$
「True.
　Hot springs are nice, but this isn't bad either.」

stage0056_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Look, $$カミーユ$$!
　Lieutenant $$エマ$$'s taking off her tights!）

stage0056_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Not a sight you see every day.）

stage0056_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... what's with that look...」

stage0056_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アンディ$$
（$$アマタ$$!
　Over there, $$ミコノ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ have bare legs...!）

stage0056_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Feels nice, doesn't it, $$ミコノ$$?」

stage0056_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「...Are you still bothered by that confession?」

stage0056_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Listen, $$ゼシカ$$...
　I think... I've always envied you.」

stage0056_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「You're always so straightforward and honest
　with your feelings... that's why you could
　tell $$アマタ$$ how you felt so openly...」

stage0056_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Well... a lot happened before I got there,
　though. I'm the one who envies you, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0056_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You're always so brave and hardworking...
　I bet every guy out there likes girls
　like you, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0056_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「T-that's not true...!
　You're more popular with guys, $$ゼシカ$$...!」

stage0056_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No...
　When it really counts, I think guys end up
　choosing girls like you, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0056_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah... the kind you just want to protect...」

stage0056_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I don't think that's always true, though.」

stage0056_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I think that's different for everyone.」

stage0056_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シェリル$$
「We're rooting for both of you equally.」

stage0056_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ランカ$$
「So... please do your best, okay?」

stage0056_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アンディ$$
「A love-triangle pair,
　and now another love-triangle pair moves in...
　This is gonna be quite a show.」

stage0056_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$n's right, $$アンディ$$.
　Today of all days, I'm going to knock
　some sense into that rotten personality of yours!」

stage0056_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa... this might actually be bad...!」

stage0056_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$n
「Say what you want, they get along well.」

stage0056_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$スズネ$$
「How are things with that nurse?」

stage0056_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No use playing dumb.
　I've had reports of you two being seen
　out on a date together.」

stage0056_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「It's... not like I was hiding it, but...」

stage0056_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... overheated from a foot bath...」

stage0056_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シン$$
（Could this be a love triangle too...!?）

stage0056_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「What is it, $$アンディ$$...!
　Dragging me all the way out here!」

stage0056_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Your body's warmed up from the footbath, right?
　Here, have some ice cream.」

stage0056_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Hey, $$ＭＩＸ$$...
　why was $$ゼシカ$$ so worked up earlier...」

stage0056_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I think she was just anxious...
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$ sightings
　have been happening one after another lately...」

stage0056_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Are you doing okay with that, $$ＭＩＸ$$?」

stage0056_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「It'd be a lie to say I'm fine...
　but I deal with my own anxiety myself.」

stage0056_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Well... you can lean on me too, you know.」

stage0056_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Thanks, $$アンディ$$.
　But I'm already relying on you plenty.」

stage0056_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「My dad, well... he left me and my mom
　behind for another woman...
　so I've always had trouble with men...」

stage0056_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「But lately... I think I've changed a little.
　Maybe it's thanks to $$アンディ$$ and
　everyone on the $c...」

stage0056_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Wh, what is it, all of a sudden...」

stage0056_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I know full well Elements are forbidden to date,
　but I'll regret it if I don't say this now...!」

stage0056_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$!
　It can wait until the world's at peace!」

stage0056_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Saying it like this feels like a death flag...
　but it's fine! There's no way I'm dying!」

stage0056_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So once this fight is over...!
　that, well, um...!」

stage0056_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Say it! Say it, $$アンディ$$...!
　I'm always just digging holes, but
　this time I want to fill your heart's hole...!）

stage0056_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アンディ$$
（I want to fill it...!
　The hole in your heart... I want to fill it!
　Your...! Your...!）

stage0056_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I want to fill... the hole in you!」

stage0056_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「N, no, that's not it!
　I mean, a hole, but not like that!
　I mean, like, spiritually...!」

stage0056_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$n
（...I can't believe even Miss $$スズネ$$
　knows about $$マキ$$...）

stage0056_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
（But there was no need to run away...）

stage0056_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right...
　the Sidereal are closing in.」

stage0056_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't move.
　I'll just touch your head a moment.」

stage0056_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you've calmed down.
　That's a welcome thing.」

stage0056_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Honestly, I wanted to join the footbath too...」

stage0056_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you're wary of me.
　...can't blame you...」

stage0056_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$n
「Good, I'll take this chance to ask you.
　Just what you and Chrono are.」

stage0056_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$n
「We also know that you're connected
　to Geminis as well.」

stage0056_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The result of $$ゼロ$$'s investigation...
　As expected of him...」

stage0056_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No wonder, seeing as he killed a god...」

stage0056_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$n
「Just what are you?
　How much do you actually know?」

stage0056_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Calm down, $n.
　I came here to tell you that.」

stage0056_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$n
「Aren't you here to team up with
　Geminis and crush us?」

stage0056_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...those connected to them
　are a faction within Chrono.」

stage0056_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　Chrono is split into two factions internally.」

stage0056_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And the faction opposing me
　is cooperating with Geminis, trying to
　accept the Prison of Time.」

stage0056_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$n
「What on earth for!?
　You called yourselves watchers over
　humanity's evolution, didn't you!」

stage0056_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「They caused $$時空震動$$, warping the world's memories...
　They must have yielded to that mighty power.」

stage0056_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$n
「Just what are you...?
　Giving up on your own and handing Earth
　over to them on your own terms...!」

stage0056_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$n
「Using words like 'watching over' us,
　when really you think you're secretly
　steering humanity's history!」

stage0056_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I have no intention of 'steering' anything.
　We won't abandon our stance as watchers.」

stage0056_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But things are accelerating.
　The 12,000-year ring of fate
　is about to close, after all.」

stage0056_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$n
「Those words... $$ロジャー$$ said them too...」

stage0056_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Paradigm City's negotiator, is it.
　He too has the right to know that.」

stage0056_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The ring of fate is closing...
　$$バアル$$'s appearances are proof of it.」

stage0056_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$n
「Humanity's natural enemy...
　Just what is this ring of fate!?」

stage0056_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That answer is one you must find yourselves.
　As those branded with the $$烙印$$.」

stage0056_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Hard to believe right away, is it?」

stage0056_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But $n... for now, just hear me out.
　As one who shares the same goal.」

stage0056_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　I too am a cursed existence, just like you.」

stage0056_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's why I'm after them... what you call angels.」

stage0056_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The reaction's growing stronger...
　So they've come close by, then.」

stage0056_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text: ～ $$ラー・カイラム$$ $$アムロ$$'s Quarters ～

stage0056_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The Altairan who took $$ジン$$'s life...!」

stage0056_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't misunderstand.
　Strictly speaking, I'm not a person of Altair.」

stage0056_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...True enough.
　I don't sense anything human from you.」

stage0056_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「As expected of a pioneer of the new humanity.
　You have good instincts.」

stage0056_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you come here to kill me?」

stage0056_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no intention of doing something so crude.
　After all, I have expectations for you.」

stage0056_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right.
　Your strength is needed to outwit them.」

stage0056_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「His lackey has come, has he...
　Do your best, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

stage0056_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Not to borrow $n's words, but
　his image... it's just like an angel...）

stage0056_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$n
「So once the battle's over, he's like this again...」

stage0056_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$シン$$
「Guess something happened with $$ＭＩＸ$$ after all.」

stage0056_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Not sure why, but for some reason
　it's perfectly ripe and delicious now.」

stage0056_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Maybe it's because of Aquarion's new move too.」

stage0056_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「By the way, where's Supreme Commander $$不動$$?」

stage0056_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$キャシー$$
「He vanished before I noticed.
　Such an elusive man.」

stage0056_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you eating too, $$ミコノ$$?」

stage0056_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah...
　It's a little embarrassing to open my
　mouth wide and take a big bite, though.」

stage0056_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's because there are men like you!」

stage0056_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Just stop already...
　Leave me alone...」

stage0056_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Looks like $$アンディ$$'s badly wounded.」

stage0056_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$ and Captain $$ガムリン$$...
　Give one of them a clear answer, okay?」

stage0056_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I... since $$アマタ$$ turned me down flat,
　I think I can smile and talk with $$ミコノ$$」

stage0056_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If $$アマタ$$ had waffled over his answer,
　I think it would've hurt even more」

stage0056_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But I'll keep loving $$アマタ$$...
　Even if it's one sided, that's fine...
　You'll let me have that much, right...」

stage0056_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is the matter, Master $$ガムリン$$?」

stage0056_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「No... I was thinking about why that
　skeleton took damage from $$バサラ$$'s song」

stage0056_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me share my own interpretation」

stage0056_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The positive power in Master $$バサラ$$'s song
　acted upon the negative power in that
　skeleton, or so I believe」

stage0056_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's the dualism ruling this whole world.
　Yin/yang, man/woman, good/evil, light/dark,
　Reds/Whites, $$シャア$$/$$アムロ$$, $$バサラ$$/$$ガムリン$$...」

stage0056_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Wait a second...!
　Isn't that last part wrong!?」

stage0056_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, anyway, that's the gist of it, so
　Master $$バサラ$$'s song must hold power
　that opposes that skeleton's」

stage0056_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Therefore its existence was neutralized,
　and it could no longer exist in this dimension」

stage0056_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I feel like I get it, and also like I don't...」

stage0056_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then how about this explanation? That
　skeleton passed on thanks to Master $$バサラ$$'s song」

stage0056_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That, I can kind of understand!」

stage0056_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... if you tell Master $$バサラ$$, I'll
　definitely get yelled at, so please don't」

stage0056_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, thanks to the skeleton's reaction
　to Master $$バサラ$$'s song, about 50 Z worth of
　Z-Chips were made. I'll add it to the squad's stock」

stage0056_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Still, I never knew a song held that kind of power...」

stage0056_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Maybe I'll try a song myself, if I get the chance」

stage0056_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, I would recommend singing
　in front of Master $$ブライト$$」

stage0056_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because, true to the name Londo Bell,
　he'll quickly ring you a bell」

stage0056_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「What is that supposed to mean!?」

stage0056_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sorry! I must excuse myself, I have
　D-Trader duty to attend to!」

stage0056_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This looks like a serious wound. How
　about a Mix Juice, for now?」

stage0056_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my... the hole in your heart just got deeper」

stage0056_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then how about listening to this
　$$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$ remix album?」

stage0056_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, my business smile, the Atomix
　Smile, to finish you off...」

stage0056_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Th-this is Master $$不動$$...!
　I was just trying to cheer up Master $$アンディ$$...」

stage0056_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$不動$$
「I am talking to $$アンディ$$」

stage0056_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$不動$$
「I must move on to my next destination.
　$$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$... I leave you with these words」

stage0056_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$不動$$
「A person who's hit rock bottom
　has nowhere to go but up from there」

stage0056_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Easy for you to say...」

stage0056_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The fact that you can still feel down
　means Master $$アンディ$$ hasn't hit rock bottom yet」

stage0056_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Give me a break...
　Is there anything worse than this...」

stage0056_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I don't know that.
　For now, just snap yourself together,
　like a manga hero... a Comix Star」

stage0056_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right! Leaving mopey people be for now,
　let's get fired up today too......business, business!」

stage0056_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today is a cosmic special day!
　A so called Cosmix Special!」
